entries.label: Eclipse Skulls
cells: You can now get Eclipse Skulls in Deathnote, unlocked at 1,000,000,000 kills. Eclipse Skulls are worth 20 points, and you also get +5% Multiplicative Damage.

entries.label: Eldritch Artifact
cells: You can now get Eldritch Artifacts from sailing, but only if you've found the Ancient form first.

entries.label: Infinite Stars
cells: Permanently transforms Star Signs into Infinite Star Signs, which always give their bonus AND don't give the negatives. Infinite Star Signs are indicated by a little infinity icon, and are transformed in a specific order, so you don't get to choose. Get more from Shiny Pets in Breeding...

entries.label: Killroy Prime
cells: The most kills you have on each monster type in Killroy's Slaughterhouse is added up, resulting in your TOTAL KILLS score. The higher this is, the higher your Damage Multiplier bonus below is, which applies to all characters all the time!

entries.label: Ruby Cards
cells: You can now level up your cards to Lv 6. Yea, you'd think it would be Lv 5 but remember, 0 stars is actually Lv 1. So yea, Ruby Cards are 5 star cards, which means they are technically lv 6!

entries.label: Sneak Mastery
cells: Once you reach the top floor of the Ninja Castle, you can restart from the bottom on a higher difficulty for increased Jade and Sneaking EXP gain, as well as a new Mastery Bonus tier! You can change which Mastery Difficulty you're on whenever you want with no penalty, don't worry.

entries.label: Stamp Mastery
cells: Every 100 total levels of all your stamps, you get a 1% chance to get a 'Gilded Stamp' 95% Reduction in Stamp Upgrade costs. This chance happens every day you log in, and they stack for whenever you want to use them!

entries.label: Trap Box Vacuum
cells: The trapper drone in World 3 will automatically collect traps every 24 hours, and will deposit the critters into your Storage Chest if there is space. The EXP from the Traps goes to the one who placed the traps.

entries.label: Vial Mastery
cells: Each Gold Crown Vial you have, which is the 13th and final vial you upgrade to for 1 Billion Resource, now gives you a 1.02x boost to ALL Vial Bonuses!

pageProps.seoDescription: Every one of the 12 rift bonuses in Legends of Idleon, and what each one connects to.
